name: Using Policy Plus
purpose: Start the program, restore its saved settings and leave it again.
members: Starts the program: restores saved settings, loads ADMX definitions and policy sources, and fills the screen.
Closes the program when a person chooses Exit.
Shows author and version information.
Re-lays out the description pane and hides its horizontal scrollbar.
Releases policy sources when the main window closes.
Regenerates PolicyPlus\Version.vb so the program carries the current Git commit description.

name: Managing policy definitions
purpose: Load, download and inspect the policy definition files (ADMX/ADML) and the products and support rules they declare.
members: Opens the detail dialog for the selected entry of the policies list.
Opens the detail dialog for the selected entry of the categories list.
Opens the detail dialog for the selected entry of the products list.
Opens the detail dialog for the selected entry of the support rules list.
Switches the dialog to show the parent category of the one displayed.
Opens the support details dialog for the policy shown.
Opens the category details dialog for the policy shown.
Resizes the name column when the list is resized.
Shows the details of the subproduct a person double-clicks.
Shows the details of the parent product.
Resizes the name column when the list is resized or the dialog is shown.
Shows the details of the product or support definition a person double-clicks.

name: Finding and browsing policies
purpose: Browse policies by category and find them by text, ID, registry location or filter.
members: Enables the product requirements box when Supported on is ticked
Closes the dialog on Escape
Resets the dialog to an empty filter
Builds a filter configuration from the choices and closes the dialog
Greys the product tree when it is disabled
Copies a ticked product's state to its child products
Drops double-click messages so a tree box's displayed check state stays in step with its value
Loads the status icons when the dialog opens
Looks up the typed ID among categories, products, support definitions and policies
Clears and focuses the ID box when shown
Closes the dialog with the chosen ID
Builds a registry key and value search from the typed terms

name: Setting policies
purpose: Choose a policy's state and option values and apply them to a computer, user or policy file, including SPOL text import and inspection.
members: Closes the dialog, reporting whether changes were applied
Fills the dialog from the chosen policy when it opens
Keeps a numeric text box inside its allowed range
Blocks non-digit keys in a numeric text box
Opens the list editor for a list element
Enables the option controls only while Enabled is chosen
Switches the dialog between the computer and user policy source
Applies the chosen state to the policy source and closes
Applies the chosen state without closing
Shares extra width between the options and help halves
Reports OK when changes were made
Lets the person pick a SPOL file and loads its text into the text box.

name: Editing policy files directly
purpose: Edit the raw keys and values of a policy (POL) file and import or export them as REG scripts.
members: Closes the editor with OK so the caller saves the edited policy file.
Closes the editor as cancelled when Escape is pressed.
Asks for a key name, checks it, and adds an empty key under the selected key.
Asks for a value name and type, then its data, and adds the value under the selected key.
Marks a value for deletion, or deletes values under a key as chosen in the delete dialog.
Removes a key with its contents, or a single value, from the policy file after confirmation.
Edits the data of the selected value in a dialog matching its type.
Enables or disables the editor buttons to match what is selected.
Opens the REG-file import dialog for the edited policy file and refreshes the list.
Opens the REG-file export dialog for the selected key.
Accepts the dialog when a delete choice is made, and asks for a value name when deleting one value.
Closes the dialog as cancelled when Escape is pressed.

name: Building and versioning Policy Plus
purpose: Stamp each build of the program with the Git commit it was made from, so the About box shows it.
members: Regenerates PolicyPlus\Version.vb so the program carries the current Git commit description.
